blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation will ask the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board and the Land Transportation Office to investigate an inDrive driver who was in a viral video arguing with passengers after taking a toll road without their consent. Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the driver should be issued a show-cause order, stressing that transport network vehicle service drivers are responsible for their passengers’ safety, comfort, and convenience. The video, which circulated on social media on Tuesday, Nov. 24, showed the inDrive driver and passengers arguing after the vehicle passed through a tollway without the passengers being […]...
